description:
Record money received against threads; records live one file per thread under the vault's payments directory.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CURRENCY] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a receipt (INTERACTIVE if THREAD is omitted)
  list [THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--as-of YYYY-MM-DD] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c CURRENCY] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change one field of a payment
  rm ID [-y] — delete a payment (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  log: -c ISO currency code, defaults to the thread's; -d date received, default today; -t time, default now; -a which account it landed in; -n free-text note; --all only affects the interactive thread picker.
  statement: --thread limit to one thread; --since, --until window; --as-of statement date driving aging, default today; --pdf render a PDF to the given path, requires --thread; --json JSON output.
  edit: --amount new amount; -c, -d, -t, -a, -n as for log.
  rm: -y skips confirmation.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "45000", "-a", "business current", "-n", "invoice 0042"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--as-of", "2026-06-30", "--json"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without both THREAD and AMOUNT and never with --all: that path opens an interactive picker on stdin.
  Amounts must be positive; there is no negative payment for refunds.
  Every payment must have a currency; a thread with no currency default requires -c.
  `statement` compares against hours entries, so unbilled hours entries (no currency) are ignored.
  ID is the 8-hex payment id; hours and payments ids share one namespace.
